spans.s:
मेथ् मेथ् (connected with rt. मिथ्,
q. v.), cl. 1. P. A. मेथति, -ते, मेथि-
तुम्, to meet; (A.) to meet one another, associate;
to reproach, revile; to strike, hurt, kill; to know,
understand.

मेथि, इस्, m. (perhaps connected with rt. 1. मि),
a pillar, post; a pillar in the middle of a threshing-
floor to which oxen are bound, any central body,
(also written मेधि, मेधी, मेढी, मेठि, मेठी,
f.; मेढी-भूत or मेधी-भूत, forming a solid
pillar or centre); a post to which cattle are tied; a
prop for supporting the shafts of a carriage; (ई), f. =
[]
मेथिका.
—मेथि-ष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. standing
at the post to which cattle are bound.

मेथिका or मेथिनी, f. a sort of grass, Trigondella
Fœnum Græcum.
